releaseDecision.instruction: 用户报告候选版手动测试没有问题，要求简化账号密码，并明确要求修改后直接发正式版。构建和自动测试仍须全部通过；未完成的扩展验收不阻塞本次发行，不记为已通过。

builds.evidence: RC2 deeb136: https://github.com/xqd922/Gomoku/actions/runs/34689136303 — all six clients, Debian 12 server and automated checks passed. The stable tag rebuilds and must pass all jobs before publishing.

online.evidence: RC1 public two-client suite passed all seven groups. RC2 HTTPS, private sign-in, invitation, moves and undo passed; its restart run exposed a readiness race, fixed with startup authentication gating and a regression test in this release. Updated production verification follows deployment of the Actions bundle.

capacity60Minutes.evidence: 10 clients / two accounts: direct-public-IP diagnostic run on RC2 has reached 2354 seconds, 1287 moves, P95 530 ms, zero transport retries; the one stream reconnection was deliberately injected. Full 60-minute completion has not yet been recorded. Earlier failed runs are retained separately.

backupRestore.evidence: 2026-09-12T13:57Z: production dump restored into an isolated local PostgreSQL 17 database, all 44 tables and row counts verified. SHA256 69614d3b3f17616aa880855157b1d177543bc839aa0dfd95760b70b71fac989b. Private dump retained locally.

existingServices.evidence: Public HTTPS and original REALITY proxy passed cutover probes. RC2 installation retained Xray, HAProxy, Caddy, Redis and PostgreSQL PIDs; current and previous app releases retained, 1446 MiB free disk.

androidManual.evidence: 2026-09-12: user reported ‘我测试过了 没啥问题了’ after agreeing to install and manually test the candidate APK. Device model and Android version were not supplied. This is user-reported acceptance, separate from CI.

windowsRuntime.evidence: Official RC2 executable passed actual Windows 11 launch, v1.1 data/settings preservation, six-move resume, accessibility/keyboard/mouse moves and undo, resize and return/resume. Full Windows-versus-Web game has not yet been recorded.

webRuntime.evidence: Production RC1 completed full gameplay/replay/rematch, restart, offline and multi-tab checks. RC2 passed the first three public groups; final-bundle repeat remains pending. Startup readiness and signed-out room recovery fixes have targeted regression coverage.
